 ☐ Deploy

│ Which deployment strategy should we use for the staging environment rollout this week?

❯ 1. Blue-green deployment with automatic traffic switching after health checks pass
     Run two identical environments and switch all traffic once the new version passes health checks.
  2. Canary release to five percent of users first then gradually increase
     Expose the new version to a small user slice first, then expand as metrics stay healthy.
  3. Rolling update
     Replace instances incrementally in batches so the service stays available throughout the whole rollout.
